summary: Iteration-6 testing of the 3 new enhancements (soft-close/reopen credit card, statement branding, custom calendar DatePicker) + accounting regression, using DELTAS and gap-invariance on global data. BACKEND: new suite /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6_features.py -> 9/9 PASS. Verified: PATCH /api/creditcards/{id}/close toggles closed (200) and 404 for unknown id; closed card still returned by GET /api/creditcards with closed=true & status='closed', excluded from ?active=true; its transactions (2), /ledger and /statement all still work after closing (no data loss); dashboard: closed card's residual outstanding STILL counted in credit_card_outstanding while credit_limit_total (-50000) / available_credit_limit (-38000) / due_reminders exclude it; total_paisa, total_profit and the Assets-Sources gap unchanged on close AND on reopen (limits fully restored). GET/PUT /api/settings roundtrip works (business_name, logo_url, no _id, 401 without token, bad logo string accepted without error). Dates: statement_date/due_date/stock date/retail sale date/card txn date/poonji date all persist exactly as sent (2026-03-01, 2026-07-xx) with no off-by-one. Regression: card purchase (outstanding 0->12000, available 28000, paisa unchanged), retail sale (account credited full 15000, profit +3000, stock -12000), partial pay bill (outstanding 7000, paisa -5000, profit unchanged), full payoff (status 'paid'), all with gap invariant. FRONTEND (Playwright, qatester login, desktop 1920 + mobile 390): Settings business name saved & persisted after reload; card created THROUGH the new calendar picker stored statement_date=2026-08-15 exactly (clicked 15 Aug); stock purchase via picker stored 2026-08-10; retail sale via picker stored 2026-08-12 with paisa +12000 / profit +3000 / stock -9000 / gap constant; poonji via picker stored 2026-08-05; calendar popover opens for stock-date, sale-date, poonji-date, paybill-date, cardtxn-date, card-statement-date, card-due-date (supply-date popover opened too; wpay/supply submit not exercised because Add Supply was disabled in that run); card-close-<id> closes (badge 'Closed', button flips to 'Reopen'), card disappears from BOTH the Stock 'Add Purchase' card dropdown and the Pay Bill dropdown, ledger route + statement panel + PDF (real %PDF jsPDF, 6.1-6.5KB, contains business name) + CSV (correct header row) all still work on the CLOSED card; reopen restores it to both dropdowns and restores dashboard limits; dashboard credit strip (cc-total-outstanding/available/limit/utilization/upcoming-due) and due-reminders-alert render; a bad logo URL (ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED) does NOT break PDF export. 4 UI defects found around the new DatePicker and closed-card actions (below).

minor.issue: credit_utilization and available_credit_limit are computed over OPEN cards only while credit_card_outstanding includes closed cards, so credit_limit_total - credit_card_outstanding != available_credit_limit (off by the closed cards' residual outstanding) and utilization is inflated (can exceed 100%). Intentional per spec but the strip is now internally inconsistent - consider computing utilization/available from the same card set or exposing open_card_outstanding.

No guard/flag preventing NEW spends/payments on a closed card (POST /creditcards/{id}/transactions and POST /stock with a closed card_id both still succeed). Backend should reject writes to a closed card (400) since the UI only hides it from dropdowns.

ui_bugs.issue: Popover does NOT close after a day is selected. It stays open on top of the form and can obstruct other fields and the submit button - reproduced: clicking the 'Add' submit button in the Add Credit Card modal timed out for 30s because the open calendar (day cell) intercepted pointer events. Fix: control Popover open state and close it in onSelect.
Pressing Escape while the calendar popover is open closes the WHOLE modal (Modal's window keydown handler) and discards all typed form data - Escape should only dismiss the popover.

A closed card still shows enabled 'Pay Bill' and 'Add Txn' buttons. Clicking the closed card's own Pay Bill sets pay.card_id to the closed card (the 'Pay full outstanding (Rs 9,000)' link proves it) while the Credit Card <select> displays 'Select card' because closed cards are filtered out of the options - inconsistent/misleading state that would post a payment against a card the UI shows as unselected. Hide/disable these actions for closed cards (or render the closed card as a disabled option).

design_issues.screen: All modals with dynamic <option> labels (Pay Bill, Stock, Retail)
issues: Carried-over React console error: '<span> cannot be a child of <option> ... will cause a hydration error' logged on every modal open. Non-blocking but noisy.

design_issues.screen: Add Purchase / Add Card modals (desktop + mobile 390px)
issues: Because the calendar popover stays open it covers 2-3 fields below/above the date field until the user clicks elsewhere; on mobile it covers Purchase Price + Payment Method. Same root cause as the HIGH bug above.

action_items: Close the DatePicker popover on day select (controlled Popover open state) - it currently blocks the submit button in the Add Credit Card modal.
Stop Escape inside the date popover from closing the parent Modal (stopPropagation / ignore Escape while popover open).
Hide or disable 'Pay Bill' and 'Add Txn' on closed cards (and/or keep the closed card as a disabled option in pay-bill-card-select) so the pre-set card_id can't mismatch the visible selection.
Backend: reject new transactions / stock purchases on a closed card with 400.
Consider making dashboard utilization/available consistent with the outstanding figure (closed-card residual outstanding currently breaks limit - outstanding = available).
Restore the shared business_name: it is currently set to 'QATEST Mobiles' (logo_url cleared) by this test run - reset it to the real shop name.

Update the stale suite /app/backend/tests/test_credit_card_module.py (3 failures: absolute baseline balance assertion, refund-vs-profit assertion, and limit-outstanding=available assertion) - all are stale expectations on global data / superseded behaviour, not new regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1143 lines - split into routers (auth/accounts/cards/stock/wholesale/dashboard/settings).
PUT /api/settings takes a raw dict (payload: dict) with no Pydantic model and no URL validation on logo_url - validate with a model and restrict logo_url to http(s).
toggle_card_close is a blind toggle; a PATCH body/explicit ?closed=true would be idempotent and safer for retries.
dashboard_summary loads every collection per call (accounts, supplies, payments, cards, poonji, stock, sales, 3 txn queries) - aggregate in Mongo as data grows.
CreditCardLedger exportCSV does not revoke the created object URL and does not quote CSV fields (only strips commas from description).

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (all 3 features functional; 3 UI defects around date popover behaviour and closed-card actions)

seed_data_creation: Card 'QATEST CloseCard' (limit 50000, statement_date 2026-08-15, left CLOSED with 9000 outstanding from stock item QATEST_UIPhone which was later sold retail for 12000). Backend suite also created QATEST_<hex>_CloseBank/_DateBank/_RegBank accounts (opening 0) and cards _CloseCard/_DateCard/_Reg/_StmClosed plus a few stock items/sales. Poonji test entry was deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression command: python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6_features.py /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5_features.py -o addopts= -v (iter5 8/8 and iter6 9/9 pass; test_credit_card_module.py has 3 STALE failures - absolute totals / refund-profit / limit-outstanding=available - fix or delete those assertions). Data is global: always use deltas + the gap (stock_value+total_paisa)-(cc_outstanding+fixed_poonji+total_profit); the gap is currently a CONSTANT 280000 and stayed constant across every operation. Playwright notes: dialogs need asyncio.ensure_future(d.accept()) (window.confirm appears when closing a card with outstanding); do NOT press Escape to dismiss a date popover (it closes the whole modal) - click the modal <h3> title instead; form inputs have no type=text attribute, select by placeholder. Card under test: QATEST CloseCard id c0242afc-e40d-4fb3-9ea4-41e8b1b560f9 (left closed).
rca_of_the_issue: DatePicker in shared.jsx renders an uncontrolled Radix Popover: onSelect only calls onChange(toYMD(d)) and never closes the popover, so the portal content (z-50, positioned over the modal) keeps intercepting pointer events - that is why clicking the modal's submit button timed out. The Escape data-loss comes from Modal registering a window-level keydown Escape handler that fires even when the popover (not the modal) should consume the key. Closed-card Pay Bill mismatch: openPay(c.id) sets pay.card_id for any card while the <select> options are built from openCards only, so the value has no matching option and the select falls back to the placeholder while the request payload would still target the closed card. Date conversion itself is correct: toYMD offsets by getTimezoneOffset and 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings are parsed as UTC, so no off-by-one was observed on any form.
